name: Volkov-Saito Precision VS-R357 Noir 'Phantom'
description:
The Volkov-Saito VS-R357 Noir is a six-shot double-action revolver chambered in .357 Magnum, finished entirely in a matte black DLC (diamond-like carbon) coating that absorbs light and eliminates reflection. The weapon is designed for discrete carry — no polished surfaces, no visible logos, no chrome or stainless gleam. Even the front sight is a low-profile black serrated ramp that disappears against dark backgrounds.

The Phantom is Volkov-Saito's concession to the tactical market. Where their other revolvers celebrate craftsmanship and visual appeal, the Noir hides both. The DLC coating is functionally superior to traditional bluing or plating — harder, more corrosion-resistant, and essentially maintenance-free — but its primary purpose is aesthetic stealth. The Phantom is a weapon designed to be invisible in a dark room, unnoticed in a holster, and unremarkable on a security camera.

The weapon underneath the coating is pure Volkov-Saito: precision-machined frame, tuned trigger, match-grade barrel. The Phantom shoots as well as any revolver in the VS lineup. It simply refuses to be seen doing it. This combination of high performance and low visibility has made it the weapon of choice for discrete protection details and individuals who need excellent capability without any visual signature.
specifications: caliber: .357 Magnum effective_range: 50 meters rate_of_fire: Double-action revolver magazine_capacity: 6 rounds (cylinder) weight: 1.0 kg
tactical_use: A precision revolver optimized for visual discretion. The DLC coating eliminates light reflection and resists environmental damage. The low-profile design minimizes printing under clothing. Performance matches Volkov-Saito's standard precision revolvers. Best suited for protection details and operators who require high capability without visual presence.
cultural_context: The Phantom is the revolver you carry when you don't want anyone to know you carry a revolver. In protection circles, it represents the philosophy that the best weapon is the one nobody knows exists until it appears. Volkov-Saito doesn't advertise the Noir — its reputation spreads through professional networks exclusively.
story_hooks: A Phantom is used in an assassination, and the lack of any reflective surface means security cameras captured nothing — no glint, no outline, no evidence that a weapon was present at all.

Volkov-Saito's DLC coating supplier is compromised, and the next batch of Phantoms ships with a coating that fluoresces under UV light — making every weapon in the batch visible to anyone with a blacklight.

physical_description.visual_profile: A six-shot revolver that seems to absorb light rather than reflect it. The silhouette is compact and traditional, but the matte black finish creates an almost void-like quality — the gun appears to recede visually even when directly observed. Clean lines, minimal protrusions, deliberately unremarkable at first glance.
physical_description.dimensions: Overall length: 19.5 cm | Barrel length: 7.6 cm | Cylinder diameter: 4.2 cm | Width at frame: 3.8 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Substantial but not burdensome — 1.0 kg feels balanced in the hand, with slight muzzle-forward weight that steadies aim without becoming unwieldy. Hefty enough to inspire confidence, light enough for extended carry without fatigue.
physical_description.primary_material: Precision-machined steel frame and cylinder, with DLC (diamond-like carbon) coating applied across all surfaces
physical_description.finish: Absolute matte black DLC coating — non-reflective, anti-glare, optically flat. No sheen whatsoever. Surface appears as a dark void under direct light rather than showing highlights or shadows.
physical_description.color_scheme: Monochromatic matte black DLC across frame, cylinder, barrel, and grips. Low-profile front sight serrated ramp in matching black. No accent colors, no manufacturer chrome trim.
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured polymer grip panels with subtle checkering pattern — provides secure purchase without visual noise or reflective surfaces. Panels are satin-finished black, flush with frame.
distinctive_features: Ultra-low-profile serrated ramp front sight that disappears against dark backgrounds
Recessed cylinder release button — no protruding lever
Flat, unadorned trigger guard with minimal radius
Cylinder chambers are utterly non-reflective due to DLC treatment
Hammer spur is serrated and squared off rather than rounded
Barrel underlug shaped to minimize shadow profile from side angles
Frame rail channels integrated flush rather than proud
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Volkov-Saito logo laser-etched into left frame rail in matte gray (barely visible), positioned at 45-degree angle to standard camera angles. 'VS-R357 NOIR' text etched along right frame in 2mm letters, same gray finish. Serial plate on right side grip panel, integrated into grip panel structure.
physical_description.condition_typical: Maintained in pristine condition — DLC coating shows no wear, no scratches, no environmental patina. The weapon is functionally maintenance-free and designed to look identical whether freshly issued or used for years. Some operators report the finish absorbing dust/powder residue, giving it a slightly textured appearance after extended use, but the black tone remains unchanged.
